bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter.name: Big Game Hunter
bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter.description: Bounty Hunter receives %kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.name: Shuriken Toss
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.description: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.scepter_description: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.lore: While the shuriken may be small, Gondar's precise aim can cause critical damage.

bounty_hunter_jinada.name: Jinada
bounty_hunter_jinada.description: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.
bounty_hunter_jinada.lore: Gondar's vast experience ensures he never walks away from a transaction empty-handed.

bounty_hunter_wind_walk.name: Shadow Walk
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.description: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.lore: The court jesters present during King Goff's assassination can recount no other image than a dancing shadow.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.note0: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.ally_description: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is %fade_time%s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.ally_lore: Useful for the rare instances when a contested bounty is actually wanted alive.

bounty_hunter_track.name: Track
bounty_hunter_track.description: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
bounty_hunter_track.lore: Using his elevated senses of sight and smell, Gondar's hits have quite a good chance of success.
bounty_hunter_track.note0: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
bounty_hunter_track.note1: Track's effect is only visible to allies.
bounty_hunter_track.note2: You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
